'''Susanoo Jinja''' (素盞嗚神社、素戔嗚神社、素盞鳴神社、素戔鳴神社、須佐之男神社) is a Shinto shrine dedicated to {{ill|Gozu Tennō|de|Gozu-Tennō|it|Gozu Tennō|ja|牛頭天王|zh|牛頭天王|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō}} and {{ill|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|abstract|Q272993|ar|سوسانو|azb|سوسانو|bcl|Susanoo|be|Сусанаа|bg|Сусаноо|ca|Susanoo|cs|Susanoo|da|Susa-no-o|de|Susanoo|el|Σουσάνoο|eo|Susanoo|es|Susanoo|eu|Susanoo|fa|سوسانو (خدا)|fi|Susanoo|fr|Susanoo|hr|Susano|hu|Szuszanoo|hy|Սուսանո|id|Susanoo|it|Susanoo|ja|スサノオ|ka|სუსანოო-ნო-მიკოტო|ko|스사노오|la|Susano'o|lb|Susanoo|mni|ꯁꯨꯁꯅꯨ-ꯅꯣ-ꯃꯤꯀꯣꯇꯣ|nl|Susanoo|pl|Susanoo|pt|Susanoo|ro|Susanoo|rsk|Сусано|ru|Сусаноо|simple|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|sl|Susanovo|sr|Сусаноо|su|Susanoo|sv|Susanoo|ta|சுசானவோ|th|ซูซาโนโอะ|tok|jan sewi Susano|tr|Susanoo|uk|Сусаноо|vi|Susanoo-no-Mikoto|zh|素戔嗚尊|zh_min_nan|Susanoo|qid=Q272993|lt=Susanoo-no-Mikoto}}, central deities in {{ill|Gion Faith|ja|祇園信仰|simple|Gion worship|qid=Q11588425|lt=Gion Faith}}. Such shrines are located throughout Japan. Variations in the name include using "戔" instead of "盞" for the second character and "鳴 (with the bird radical)" instead of "嗚 (with the crow radical)" for the third character. Other shrines associated with Gion Faith include {{ill|Yasaka Shrine (disambiguation)|de|Yasaka-Schreine|ja|八坂神社 (曖昧さ回避)|qid=Q2599651}}, {{ill|Gion shrines|ja|祇園神社|qid=Q11588442}}, {{ill|Hiromine Shrine|ja|広峯神社|simple|Hiromine Shrine|zh|廣峯神社|qid=Q11484399|lt=Hiromine Shrine}}, {{ill|Tenno Shrine|ja|天王神社|qid=Q11443028}}, {{ill|Yakumo shrine|ja|八雲神社|qid=Q11391847}}, and {{ill|Suga Shrine|ja|須賀神社|ko|스가 신사|qid=Q11253400}}, which vary in usage across periods and sources.

Susanoo may also be written as 素盞雄, 須佐男, 須佐之男, 進雄, or 素盞雄, often with the addition of "命" (Mikoto) or "尊."

Until the Edo period, these shrines were generally referred to as '''Gozu Tennōsha''', venerating {{ill|Gozu Tennō|de|Gozu-Tennō|it|Gozu Tennō|ja|牛頭天王|zh|牛頭天王|qid=Q11570247|lt=Gozu Tennō}}. Their main shrines are located in Kyoto at {{ill|Yasaka Shrine|bcl|Yasaka Shrine|ca|Santuari de Yasaka|de|Yasaka-Schrein|el|Ιερό Γιασάκα|es|Santuario Yasaka|fa|معبد یاساکا|fr|Yasaka-jinja|hu|Jaszaka-szentély|id|Kuil Yasaka|it|Santuario di Yasaka|ja|八坂神社|ko|야사카 신사|my|ယဆခနတ်ကျောင်း|pl|Yasaka-jinja|pt|Santuário Yasaka|ru|Ясака дзиндзя|simple|Yasaka Shrine|th|ศาลเจ้ายาซากะ|tr|Yasaka Tapınağı|uk|Храм Ясака|zh|八坂神社|qid=Q692714|lt=Yasaka Shrine}} or in Hyōgo Prefecture at {{ill|Hiromine Shrine|ja|広峯神社|simple|Hiromine Shrine|zh|廣峯神社|qid=Q11484399|lt=Hiromine Shrine}}.
